meta.title: AgentBridge — Permission Evaluation Workflow
meta.subtitle: Deterministic Layered Precedence Resolution
meta.description: Deterministic 5-tier evaluation chain for permission requests: CRITICAL safety invariants → Active Session Grants → Project-scoped Policies → Global Policies → Default Engine Risk Rules.

nodes.label:
Agent Request
(action, risk_level)
nodes.description: Action requested by an AI agent (e.g., file_write, bash_exec, git_push) received by PolicyEngine.check_permission().

nodes.label:
Is Action or Risk
CRITICAL?
nodes.description: Hard-coded safety invariant: CRITICAL actions (e.g., destructive delete, rm -rf, drop table) cannot be auto-approved by any persistent or session policy.

nodes.label:
Require Explicit
Telegram Approval (Once)
nodes.description: CRITICAL actions must always be prompted to the human operator for explicit one-time approval.

nodes.label:
Has Active
Session Grant?
nodes.description: Check if an active session-scoped grant exists for (session_id, action_type). Grants expire automatically when session ends.

nodes.label:
AUTO ALLOW
(Session Grant)
nodes.description: Action allowed based on temporary session authorization granted earlier by the user.

nodes.label:
Matches Project
Policy?
nodes.description: Check SQLite PolicyStore for enabled project-scoped policy matching workspace_path and action_type (or wildcard '*').

nodes.label:
Evaluate Project
Decision
nodes.description: If project policy is 'allow', check that risk is not CRITICAL and allow. If 'deny', reject immediately. If 'ask', prompt user.

nodes.label:
Matches Global
Policy?
nodes.description: Check SQLite PolicyStore for enabled global policy matching action_type (or wildcard '*').

nodes.label:
Evaluate Global
Decision
nodes.description: If global policy is 'allow', auto-allow non-critical. If 'deny', reject immediately. If 'ask', prompt user.

nodes.label: Default Engine Risk Assessment
nodes.description: Fallback to existing PermissionEngine: LOW risk auto-approved; MEDIUM and HIGH ask user via Telegram.

nodes.label:
Telegram Callback
Handling
nodes.description: Operator responds via Telegram inline keyboard: Allow Once, Allow Session, Deny, or Modify. Decision recorded in audit log.

nodes.label:
Write Audit Log
Entry
nodes.description: Policy decision and execution timestamp written to SQLite policy_audit_log table.

nodes.label:
EXECUTION
ALLOWED
nodes.description: Tool / command execution permitted and dispatched to local runtime.

nodes.label:
EXECUTION
DENIED
nodes.description: Tool / command rejected with descriptive security reason.
